mapper.select: SELECT SERIAL_NUMBER, REGIST_DATE, REGIST_IP, MODIFY_DATE, MODIFY_IP, CANCEL_BIT, CANCEL_REASON, USE_BIT, CODE_TYPE, SUBJECT, MEMO FROM CM_BIKE_ITEM_CD WHERE CANCEL_BIT = 'N' AND USE_BIT = 'Y' ORDER BY SERIAL_NUMBER

SELECT SERIAL_NUMBER, REGIST_DATE, REGIST_IP, MODIFY_DATE, MODIFY_IP, CANCEL_BIT, CANCEL_REASON, USE_BIT, CODE_TYPE, SUBJECT, MEMO FROM CM_BIKE_ITEM_CD WHERE CANCEL_BIT = 'N' AND SERIAL_NUMBER = #{serialNumber}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CM_BIKE_ITEM_CD ( REGIST_DATE, REGIST_IP, CANCEL_BIT, CANCEL_REASON, USE_BIT, CODE_TYPE, SUBJECT, MEMO ) VALUES ( NOW(), #{registIp}, 'N', '00', #{useBit}, #{codeType}, #{subject}, #{memo} )
mapper.update: UPDATE CM_BIKE_ITEM_CD SET MODIFY_DATE = NOW(), MODIFY_IP = #{modifyIp}, USE_BIT = #{useBit}, CODE_TYPE = #{codeType}, SUBJECT = #{subject}, MEMO = #{memo} WHERE SERIAL_NUMBER = #{serialNumber}
UPDATE CM_BIKE_ITEM_CD SET CANCEL_BIT = 'Y', CANCEL_DATE = NOW() WHERE SERIAL_NUMBER = #{serialNumber}
